name: Alfred Lawson, Jr.
summary: Alfred James Lawson Jr. (born September 23, 1948) is an American former politician who was the U.S. representative for Florida's 5th congressional district from 2017 to 2023. The district, which was eliminated following redistricting during the 2022 Florida legislative session, stretched across most of the border with Georgia, including most of the majority-black areas between Tallahassee and Jacksonville.
